E0398

`!` needs a Bool operand.

What

`!` needs a Bool operand.

Why

`!` negates a Bool; integer bits use named methods.

Fix

Write `value.bit_not()` to flip integer bits.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0398: tests/ui/sigil_integer_not_retired.stderr.

Error [jet.LogicalNotOnNonBool]: `!` needs Bool; use `bit_not` to flip integer bits
  --> sigil_integer_not_retired.jet:2:11
    |
  2 |     print(!1)
    |           ^^
 Why: Marks express ownership and outcomes; arithmetic uses named methods
 Fix: Write `value.bit_not()` for an integer, or compare the value to produce Bool
